rungs.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
rungs.summary: Learning pipelines, servers and how releases reach production.
rungs.knowledge: Knows Linux, Git, containers and the basics of the company's pipeline.
rungs.delivery: Handles routine pipeline and server tasks from runbooks, with review.
rungs.leadership: Documents what they do and flags risk early.

rungs.title: DevOps Engineer
rungs.summary: Builds and runs pipelines and environments reliably.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in CI/CD, containers, cloud basics and monitoring.
rungs.delivery: Builds and maintains pipelines and environments; responds to incidents.
rungs.leadership: Works with developers to make releases boring; writes clear runbooks.

rungs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
rungs.summary: Owns the platform, its security and its reliability.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in infrastructure as code, observability and security operations.
rungs.delivery: Owns the platform: availability, cost, security and recovery.
rungs.leadership: Leads incident response and mentors; builds relationships with every team that ships.

rungs.title: Platform Lead
rungs.summary: Leads the platform team and its roadmap.
rungs.knowledge: Balances reliability, cost, security and developer speed across the company.
rungs.delivery: Plans and delivers platform work; owns uptime targets and recovery tests.
rungs.leadership: Leads a team; speaks for infrastructure in architecture and budget decisions.

rungs.title: Head of Infrastructure
rungs.knowledge: Sees infrastructure as risk, cost and capability for the whole company.
rungs.delivery: Owns infrastructure strategy, budget and resilience.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and advises executives on risk and spend.
